semantics.function: Original Karnaugh map, column pair {x[0],x[1]}, row pair {x[2],x[3]}, both ordered 00,01,11,10
semantics.timing: Combinational; no clock, state, or added latency
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified
semantics.initialization: No stored state; output depends on current input after combinational settling

numeric.input: Unsigned four binary bits, individually selected according to map labels
numeric.arithmetic: No rounding, overflow, saturation, or arithmetic

verification.oracle: Direct original map lookup using explicit Gray-order row/column decoding, independent of RTL Boolean equation
verification.coverage: All 16 binary inputs ascending and descending to check transitions and absence of retention
verification.sampling: Drive input then wait 1 ns for combinational settling
verification.failure: Case inequality and $fatal; bounded timeout; PASS only after all checks

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original map specifies binary cells only
specification_ambiguities.resolution: No additional X/Z requirement inferred; exhaustive checks cover binary inputs
